metro.basis: Token / QR single-journey fare by chargeable distance between entry and exit station (one fare across interchanges).
caveats: In Feb 2025 BMRCL hand-adjusted roughly 600 of 4,624 station pairs, so some pairs differ from the slab table.
Distance here is measured along the OSM track geometry, which can differ slightly from BMRCL's chargeable distance.
A 5% revision announced on 2026-02-05 was put in abeyance on 2026-02-09; status re-checked 2026-10-22.
Some sources print the 10-15 km slab as 10-12 km.

bmtc.basis: Ordinary (non-AC) stage fare. Only the first stages are reliably published; longer trips have no verified fare in this app.
bmtc.shakti: Women resident in Karnataka travel free on BMTC non-AC ordinary buses (Shakti scheme, since 2023-06-11). Vajra / Vayu Vajra / EV Power Plus are excluded.
caveats: The full post-January-2025 stage table could not be verified from an official BMTC source on 2026-10-22.
AC (Vajra / Vayu Vajra) fares are not bundled.

rideHailing.note: No ride-hailing fare is calculated by this app. Uber and Rapido show the real fare in their own apps before you confirm.
